title: FUMI Zingy Ginger Nicotine Pouches
description: FUMi Zingy Ginger Nicotine Pouches offer a flavour that stands apart—warming Ginger with a subtle hint of Cola-style sweetness for a gently spiced, slightly unusual experience. Smooth and satisfying, it’s ideal for pouch users who enjoy something different from standard fruit or mint profiles. Each slim, all-white pouch sits discreetly under the lip and delivers a gradual release of nicotine and flavour over up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, FUMi pouches provide a clean, versatile alternative to other nicotine formats. Choose between 4mg (Regular) and 8mg (Strong) strengths depending on your preference. Each can contains 20 pouches, made from soft plant-based fibres and manufactured in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Regular - 4mg this is best for new users. Extra Strong - 11mg this is suited for more experienced users. How To Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
